description_en: Retrieves the details of a host, such as the name, source, address, protocol, and service port
description_zh: 包括主机名称、来源、主机地址、协议端口等信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHost

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host in which you want to query the host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host that you want to query. You can specify only one host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the ID of the host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机ID。仅支持输入一个主机ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

Host.description_en: The returned information about the host

ActiveAddressType.description_en:
The address type of the host. Valid values:

Public: a public address

Private: a private address
ActiveAddressType.description_zh:
主机地址类型。取值：
Public ：公网地址
Private ：私网地址

HostPrivateAddress.description_en: The internal endpoint of the host. The value is a domain name or an IP address
HostPrivateAddress.description_zh: 主机的私网地址，可为域名或IP地址

HostPublicAddress.description_en: The public address of the host. The value is a domain name or an IP address
HostPublicAddress.description_zh: 主机的公网地址，可为域名或IP地址

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain to which the host belongs

OSType.description_en:
The operating system of the host. Valid values:

Linux

Windows
OSType.description_zh:
主机的操作系统。取值：
Linux
Windows

PrefKex.description_en:
The preferred key exchange algorithm of the host. The value of this parameter is returned if OSType is set to Linux. Valid values:

default

diffie-hellman-group1-sha1

diffie-hellman-group14-sha1

diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1
PrefKex.description_zh:
主机首选密钥交换算法配置。当OSType为Linux时有返回值。

default：默认模式
diffie-hellman-group1-sha1：diffie-hellman-group1-sha1算法兼容模式
diffie-hellman-group14-sha1：diffie-hellman-group14-sha1算法兼容模式
diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1：diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1算法兼容模式

Protocols.description_en: The protocol information about the host

HostFingerPrint.description_en: The fingerprint of the host. This parameter uniquely identifies a host. A value is returned for this parameter only if you have performed O\&M operations on the host by using the bastion host. Otherwise, no value is returned
HostFingerPrint.description_zh: 主机指纹信息，可以唯一标识一台主机。只有通过堡垒机运维目标主机时，堡垒机才会记录主机指纹，否则返回为空

Port.description_en: The service port of the host

ProtocolName.description_en:
The protocol that is used to connect to the host. Valid values:

SSH

RDP
ProtocolName.description_zh:
主机使用的协议名称。取值：
SSH
RDP

Source.description_en:
The source of the host. Valid values:

Local: a host in a data center

Ecs: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance

Rds: a host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster
Source.description_zh:
主机的来源。取值：
Local：本地主机
Ecs：ECS实例
Rds：RDS专属集群主机

SourceInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the ECS instance or the host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster.

If Local is returned for the Source parameter, no value is returned for this parameter
SourceInstanceId.description_zh:
主机对应的ECS实例ID或专属集群主机ID。
Source为Local时，该参数返回值为空

SourceInstanceState.description_en:
The status of the host. Valid values:

Normal: normal

Release: released
SourceInstanceState.description_zh:
主机状态。取值：
Normal   ：正常
Release： 已释放

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
